actual: The self-hosted PR CI frontend-quality job runs actions/checkout with clean=true, whose git clean -ffdx deletes the ignored frontend/node_modules tree. The next Verify prebuilt frontend toolchain step then fail-closes because node_modules is absent, so every frontend-required PR is blocked before type, lint, or module tests. Reuse the BUG-1228 lockfile-matched read-only junction contract after checkout; do not install, copy, skip, or weaken frontend validation.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
